parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, AA Property. Can I help you?

Yes, good morning. I'm looking for an apartment to rent.

OK. Is that here in Birmingham?

That's right.

Right. I'll just take some personal details if I may. So, if I can just take your name?

Kevin Walker.

Right. And can I have your present address, please?

Well, we're staying with friends at present, so the address is 354 Forest Road.

Is that Forest with one R?

That's right.

And that's in West Bromwich. I'm afraid I don't know the postcode.

That's OK.

And a contact phone number?

07817983602.

Lovely. And if I could just ask your occupation?

Certainly. I'm a dentist and my wife’s a teacher, but she’s at home with the children looking after them.

OK. So, I'll just put your occupation. Right. Well, now I'll take some details about the kind of property you're looking for. You said you're looking for an apartment, is that right?

Yeah.

OK. So, how many bedrooms do you want?

Two.

And did you want it furnished?

No, unfurnished.

Right. Well, that gives you quite a bit more choice, so that's good. And what’s the maximum rent you'd be prepared to pay?

Well, we'd like to stay under £600 if possible, but we could go up to £650 for the right place.

Right. So, do you have any other definite requirements?

Well, coming back to the bedrooms, they have to be doubles, both of them.

OK. I'll make a note of that.

So, are you looking for something straight away? I assume you are if you're staying with friends.

Well, as soon as possible, yes.

Well, it's October 17th today, so we're probably looking at November 1st at the earliest. Would that be OK?

Well, I'd have preferred something in October, but OK, let's put that date down for now. Fine.

Now, is there anything else you'd like?

Well, our last flat had a garage, but actually, we never used it, so I'm not really worried about that.

But we'd like a balcony if possible. It's nice not to be too shut in.

Yes. You'll find most modern apartments do have one. It's only the converted properties that don't. But of course, if you're in an older property, you might have use of a garden. Would that be a possible alternative?

Oh yes, either of those would be good.

What about transport? Would you want off-street parking?

No, parking doesn't matter, but it'd be good to have somewhere not too far from a station if possible. But it's not essential. I've got a bike.

Right. And what else? You'll want a lounge, and will you want a separate dining room?

Well, not really. We tend to eat in the kitchen, so it'd be good if that was large enough for us to do that.

That might be difficult, but I'll make a note of it anyway. Right, well, let's have a look at what...

analyses.content: 男生直接报出了当前的详细门牌号和路名，并确认了单词 "Forest" 的拼写。
Kevin: Well, we're staying with friends at present, so the address is 354 Forest Road. Agent: Is that Forest with one R? Kevin: That's right.
题目空格后已经有了 Road，所以这里需要填完整的门牌号+路名，不要漏掉数字 354。
Agent: And a contact phone number? Kevin: 07817983602.
这道题纯考反应速度，注意数字之间没有停顿，要一口气记下来，不要写错位。
听到 "contact phone number" 后，直接快速记录男生报出的一长串数字即可。

Agent: Lovely. And if I could just ask your occupation? Kevin: Certainly. I'm a dentist and my wife’s a teacher, but she’s at home with the children looking after them. Agent: OK. So, I'll just put your occupation.
不要听到 teacher 就顺手填上，题目问的是男生的 Occupation，而且 teacher 是干扰项。
男生介绍自己是 dentist（牙医），虽然顺带提了妻子是 teacher，但中介明确说只记录“你的职业”。
Agent: And did you want it furnished? Kevin: No, unfurnished. Agent: Right. Well, that gives you quite a bit more choice...
这是一个典型的否定陷阱，不要听到原文里有 furnished 就直接填，要听完前面的 "No"。
中介问是否要配家具（furnished），男生明确拒绝并回答 "No, unfurnished"（不要家具）。
Kevin: Well, coming back to the bedrooms, they have to be doubles, both of them. Agent: OK. I'll make a note of that.
原文强调了 "both of them"（两个都是），所以这里必须填复数 doubles，填单数属于语法错误扣分。
男生强调两个卧室必须都是 doubles（双人间），这是一个硬性要求。
虽然男生想十月入住，但中介说最早也要 November 1st，男生最后妥协说 "put that date down"。

Agent: Well, it's October 17th today, so we're probably looking at November 1st at the earliest. Would that be OK? Kevin: Well, I'd have preferred something in October, but OK, let's put that date down for now.
千万不要填 "October 17th"，那只是对话发生时的“今天”日期，不是入住日期。
Kevin: Well, our last flat had a garage, but actually, we never used it... But we'd like a balcony if possible. It's nice not to be too shut in.
原文先提到了 garage（车库），但男生紧接着说 "never used it"（从未用过），所以这是干扰项，不要填。
男生明确提出想要一个 balcony（阳台），因为不喜欢被关在屋子里的感觉。
Agent: ...if you're in an older property, you might have use of a garden. Would that be a possible alternative? Kevin: Oh yes, either of those would be good.
题目是 "have a ... or a ... "，garden 是作为 balcony 的替代方案出现的，符合题目逻辑。
中介提议如果是旧房子可能会有 garden（花园），男生表示阳台和花园“二者有其一就行”。
Agent: Would you want off-street parking? Kevin: No, parking doesn't matter, but it'd be good to have somewhere not too far from a station if possible.
男生明确说了 "parking doesn't matter"（停车不重要），所以不要被 parking 这个词干扰。
男生希望住处 "not too far from a station"（离车站不远），完美对应题目中的 "be near a ..."。
Agent: ...and will you want a separate dining room? Kevin: Well, not really. We tend to eat in the kitchen, so it'd be good if that was large enough for us to do that.
中介先问了 separate dining room（独立餐厅），男生说了 "not really"（不需要），这是用来排除的干扰信息。
因为这家人习惯在厨房吃饭，所以男生希望 kitchen（厨房）足够大。
